messages:
Alex W: Quick heads-up — opened a docs PR to add a fallback playbook for Dedicated provisioning. It bundles a short latency SLO explainer, an autoscale YAML example, and a tiny SDK snippet. PTAL: https://go/repo/pr/4532 :eyes:
Marta D: Saw it, thanks. One thing: the SLA table currently implies p99 <= 50ms for burst; that's misleading for burst-capacity. We should split 'normal' vs 'burst' rows.
Alex W: Agreed. Proposed wording: 'Target p99 under steady-state operation; burst scaling may increase p99 temporarily. See fallback steps.'
Paige SRE: +1. Also please call out preemption behavior during scale-up (we've had customers surprised by eviction order). Short note and link to runbook will help.
Samir: I can add a python snippet showing how to attach a scale policy via the SDK. Inline or separate file?
Alex W: Inline in the doc is best for discoverability. Wrap in a fenced block.
Samir: Added this in the draft section of the PR: ```python
from redwood import DedicatedClient
client = DedicatedClient()
client.create_scale_policy(tenant_id="t-123", policy={"mode":"burst","max_instances":50,"cooldown":300})
```
Lina: Found two broken links that pointed to the old handbook path — I'll replace with /docs/dedicated/scale-policies and push a fix.
Marta D: For the autoscale YAML example, can we show both a burst policy and a stable policy (with cooldowns)? Current example only shows burst.
Alex W: Good call. Proposed extra YAML to illustrate interplay:
```yaml
scalePolicies:
  - name: burst-policy
    mode: burst
    maxInstances: 50
    cooldown: 300
  - name: stable-policy
    mode: stable
    minInstances: 2
    targetUtilization: 0.65
    cooldown: 600
```
Paige SRE: Also include a one-line note on isolation labels so infra won't evict reserved tenants: `tenant:isolation=reserved`.
Alex W: Will add a short callout under 'Isolation & Preemption'.
Samir: Small nit: the SDK example should mention exceptions on create_scale_policy so users know to handle AlreadyExists / InvalidConfig.
Alex W: Yup — add a try/except snippet or a note.
Docs Bot: PR preview build queued — preview url: https://go/docs-preview/4532 (rendering may take ~30s).
Lina: Pushed the link fixes and updated the internal anchors.
Marta D: LGTM except for one phrasing tweak on SLA row 3 (replace "guarantee" with "target").
Alex W: I'll make the wording change and squash the commits. Will also add a cross-ref to incident-1234 runbook for fallback steps as Paige suggested.
Paige SRE: Thanks — that incident had a useful checklist (step 2 is to fall back to smaller model variant + enable forced KV cache warmup). Add that as a numbered step.
Alex W: Done — added numbered fallback steps and linked the runbook.
Samir: I added a tiny unit test to verify code snippet renders correctly in the docs pipeline.
Lina: CI green for the preview build.
Marta D: Approved in the PR review.
Alex W: Merging after a quick CI sanity run. Will follow up with a screenshot of the console example in a separate PR if folks want it.
Samir: Screenshot would be helpful for the tutorial flow. I'll grab one once the doc is live.
Alex W: Thanks everyone :tada:
Docs Bot: PR merged — live at https://docs.redwood.ai/dedicated/provisioning#fallback-playbook (caches may take a minute).
